g.text: UML - durable Finance audit progress and native receipt recovery
Commit original ID / actor / occurrence time / payload
Commit cursor at current attempted identity
Retain safe failure attempt; keep original pending
Native confirmation inquiry by original ID
Verify ID / finance stream / exact payload / native digest
Append original ID / stream / exact payload
Idempotent append; stream lock / original chain
Original accepted digest or unknown transport outcome
Verify original scope and digest; never trust caller flag
Immutable receipt + acknowledgment in one transaction
Retain safe attempt; original source digest
Empty page resets cursor; failures retried after wrap
Workforce GET list / saved event URL
Verify receipt against original native event
Safe IDs / codes / digest / native receipt; no raw payload
A failed or uncertain audit attempt does not determine financial outcome.
No original record is deleted, rewritten or marked delivered without native evidence.
No transaction spans Controls append and Finance acknowledgment.
